input: T2 canonical B0 seed0 traces and exact case metadata; B_OLD SourceFFD observation with unchanged T2 mu/C and controls
event_membership: C03 A/B half-open x=[1,4), maximal contiguous actual RF-row runs, visit1, t>=0, at least3 RF frames. Map to motion first RF index through last RF index+1. Frozen pose membership only, never outcome/GT-error selection. O01 initial region unspecified by original request: fixed inclusive time [0,5] seconds, actual RF rows, no geometry proxy or outcome selection.
initialization: Copy canonical_engine.PINIT, which has zero initial cross terms. Change only specified physical covariance diagonal; scale means variance, not standard deviation. bg sigma is converted from deg/s to rad/s and squared. All initial means, RF observations, learned parameters, radio mask, controls and truth arrays remain unchanged. BASELINE and sigma0.1 duplicate intentionally retained.
counterfactual: For each initialization use identical changed P in FULL and SKIP; skip updates only inside fixed initial event, afterwards original POWER1 persists. No GT prior reset. Geometric event ablation comparison is ORACLE_DIAGNOSTIC.
scope: all motion samples at t>=evaluation_start; also RF-only at same starts for comparison. Main T5 criterion t>=30 all motion.

decision.baseline_skip_gain: Heading RMSE FULL baseline minus SKIP baseline; positive is harmful event
decision.effect_removed: 1 - abs(changed_P_skip_gain)/abs(baseline_skip_gain). Sign reversal alone does not imply removal; abs reduction must reach50%.
decision.supported: C03 A baseline skip gain positive and nonzero, and any of nine predeclared nonbaseline settings removes>=50% of its magnitude at t>=30. SUPPORTED_BUT_LIMITED: initialization sensitivity in replay; do not claim multipath impossible or sole cause.
decision.otherwise: NOT_ESTABLISHED; comparison cases C03B/O01 do not replace primary case and all settings reported, no tuning or selected universal setting

verification.covariance: Every prior/posterior finite and positive definite; preserve errors without repair

independence_and_limits: Same corridor/office scene families, motion noise fixed seed0. No independent-scene generalization, normalized Bayesian posterior, or hardware validation. SOURCE model change or sensor change needs new protocol version and additive outputs.
